jou.text: Setessa is the polis where Raissa, during her pregnancy, consults the starfish in a tidal pool and sees twins, then the boy crowding out the girl until only one child remains.
She sees a vision of her son fully grown with horns and destined to be a king, and she decides not to abandon him to Setessa as most satyr women would, believing he is special and needs her.
Years later, Raissa and her six-year-old son have been cast out of Setessa after he pushed the son of a council member of the Karametra temple to his death from a high rope bridge among the trees.
They return to the tidal pools and find the starfish again, and the vision ends with the boy laughing and holding aloft his stick with the impaled body of the starfish on it.
